commands.name: help
commands.stdout:
usage: benchmark_global_gpu_capacity.py [-h] --prepared-input PREPARED_INPUT
                                        --full-reference-dir
                                        FULL_REFERENCE_DIR
                                        --memory-baseline-dir
                                        MEMORY_BASELINE_DIR --output-dir
                                        OUTPUT_DIR [--config CONFIG]
                                        [--asset-root ASSET_ROOT]
                                        [--baseline-ref BASELINE_REF]
                                        [--warm-repeats WARM_REPEATS]
                                        [--budget-seconds BUDGET_SECONDS]
                                        [--conditional-512]
                                        [--continue-256-512 | --continue-512]
                                        [--b128-baseline-dir B128_BASELINE_DIR]
                                        [--b256-baseline-dir B256_BASELINE_DIR]
                                        [--optional-b64-baseline] [--dry-run]
                                        [--admit-inputs]

Fixed-512-lane GPU capacity screen; repeated real inputs are not new points.
No process logic: execution uses the audited global_batch transition factory
and benchmark_global_batch.run_two unchanged (complete Days2-8 and9-15). The
unique FULL64 preparation/reference remains immutable numerical evidence.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prepared-input PREPARED_INPUT
  --full-reference-dir FULL_REFERENCE_DIR
  --memory-baseline-dir MEMORY_BASELINE_DIR
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --config CONFIG
  --asset-root ASSET_ROOT
  --baseline-ref BASELINE_REF
  --warm-repeats WARM_REPEATS
  --budget-seconds BUDGET_SECONDS
  --conditional-512
  --continue-256-512    Import sealed B128 timing origin; measure only B256
                        then resource-admitted B512, regardless of speedup.
  --continue-512        Import sealed B128/B256 origins and B256 compiler
                        memory; measure only resource-admitted B512.
  --b128-baseline-dir B128_BASELINE_DIR
  --b256-baseline-dir B256_BASELINE_DIR
  --optional-b64-baseline
  --dry-run
  --admit-inputs        Read/audit FULL64 and repeated identities only; no
                        process factory or compilation.
